prompt.description: Text description for video generation. Refer to references by what they show.
prompt.title: Prompt

images.description: Reference images (up to 9 including first and last frames; 20 MiB, 4096 px each).
images.title: Images

videos.description: Reference videos (up to 3; 2-15s each, 15s combined, up to 1080p/60 fps).
videos.title: Videos

audios.description: Reference audio (up to 3, 15s combined). Set keep_audio to use one file as the soundtrack.
audios.title: Audios

keep_audio.description: Keep the single audio file as the video's audio. Needs exactly one audio file.
keep_audio.title: Keep Audio

first_frame_image.description: Optional opening image (soft keyframe, counts as a reference image).
first_frame_image.title: First Frame Image

last_frame_image.description: Optional closing image (soft keyframe, counts as a reference image).
last_frame_image.title: Last Frame Image

resolution.description: 480p or 768p native. 1080p, 2k and 4k generate at 768p and upscale.

prompt_upsampler.description: Rewrite the prompt before generation: turbo, max or off. Frame images force turbo.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. adaptive follows the references.

enable_safety_filter.description: Check inputs against the content policy. Always-on categories are blocked either way.
enable_safety_filter.title: Enable Safety Filter
